CustomObject.description: Secure storage for VA Lighthouse API credentials and sensitive configuration values. Protected custom settings provide enhanced security for API keys and sensitive data.
CustomObject.label: CVMA VA API Keys

fields.description: Encrypted API key or sensitive credential value
fields.inlineHelpText: Store the actual API key, client secret, or other sensitive credential value. This field is automatically encrypted in Protected Custom Settings.
fields.label: API Key Value

fields.description: Type of credential stored (Client ID, Client Secret, API Key, etc.)
fields.inlineHelpText: Specify the type of credential being stored for easier management
fields.label: Key Type

fields.description: Environment this credential applies to (Sandbox, Production, Development)
fields.inlineHelpText: Specify the environment to ensure correct credentials are used in each org
fields.label: Environment

fields.description: Whether this credential is currently active and should be used
fields.inlineHelpText: Uncheck to temporarily disable this credential without deleting it
fields.label: Is Active

fields.description: Timestamp when this credential was last successfully used
fields.inlineHelpText: Automatically updated when the credential is successfully used for API authentication
fields.label: Last Used

fields.description: Optional expiration date for this credential
fields.inlineHelpText: Set an expiration date if the credential has a known expiry (optional)
fields.label: Expires On
